population-density.def: The number of people for each unit of land, usually per square kilometer.

arithmetic-density.def: The total population divided by the total land area. It shows how crowded a place is on average.

physiological-density.def: The total population divided by the area of arable land. It shows how many people each unit of farmland must feed.

agricultural-density.def: The number of farmers divided by the area of arable land. A low value usually means large farms that use machines.

arable-land.def: Land that can be used to grow crops. It leaves out deserts, ice, steep mountains and built-up areas.

carrying-capacity.def: The number of people an area can support without damaging it. It depends on resources, technology and trade, so it is not the same as density.
